description: Step 2 of uploading a local file: call it once the bytes have been PUT to the url create_upload returned — by you, or by the user — which starts processing. Until this is called the media is unusable, and calling it before the PUT finishes leaves a broken record. Nothing to call for a url import: import_upload_from_url completes on its own.
